details:
In recent years, VRChat's PerformanceRank has barely functioned.

This is because there's no penalty for being judged as Very Poor, and some have called for the limit to be increased.

(This article does not offer opinions on the numerical levels of the restrictions themselves, so we will not discuss them here.)

Now is the time to reinstate the polygon upload limit so users don't get lazy.

It's true that polygon count has less impact on performance compared to other factors.

But.

In many cases, people who can't even bother with the most obvious number, polygon count, often end up with equally poor textures and PhysBones.

Rather than limiting the polygons themselves, we should reinstate the limit, saying, "If you can't even manage these obvious numbers, you don't deserve to upload."

However, I think the number should be increased to 500,000, or even a more lenient 1 million.

Just like the TextMemory limit is 500MB.

(Personally, I think a limit of around 300,000 would be fine, but I think some players won't like that, so we need to carefully monitor their reactions.)
title: Time to bring back the polygon count upload limit.
